## About
Grace Movers is a locally owned moving company based in Fort Worth. We move residences and places of business all over the DFW Metroplex, and we try to be dependable, careful and on time.
We know how stressful a move can be. Our goal is to make your move one less thing to worry about, and we handle your things with the same care and respect we would give our own.
Customers have given us a 5 star rating across 268 Google reviews. Your recommendation is the best compliment we can receive.

## Services
- Residential and commercial moves: We move homes and businesses within the DFW Metroplex.
- Packing: Our crew can pack for you before moving day.
- Artwork hanging: Once you are moved in, we can hang your artwork.
- Pianos, safes and grandfather clocks: We move heavy and awkward items that take extra care.

## FAQ
Q: What area do you serve?
A: We move customers within the DFW Metroplex.

Q: Do you take credit cards?
A: Yes, we accept all major credit cards.
